title: Generate source-linked calculations and validations
changes: Add an operator CLI that derives supported calculations and validations from original Forms XML and an exact matching parent APEX package.
Generate a CEIL report calculation or a linked numeric-validation page with explicit button, minimum-value and focus behavior; retain source references and web adaptations.
Keep an individual status for every source code unit and require fresh SQLcl format validation for the derivative package without reusing parent validation claims.
limitations: Development preview: source and local checks do not establish a public deployment or completed fresh-customer installation.

The first behavior generator is an operator CLI/library, not part of the normal web generation action. It supports two complete source patterns; other business code remains explicitly unsupported. The validation page does not save changes.
Development-source processing requires explicit approval for the selected code and configured provider. Existing masked-source approvals and retained jobs keep their original meaning.
Format validation is not customer-target import testing, runtime verification or business acceptance; no universal import or behavior guarantee is made.
Supported Oracle Forms tooling, Java and SQLcl remain external prerequisites. Export-only jobs reuse configured provider and compatibility metadata without a live target connection.
The primary new output is an APEXlang ZIP with synthetic supporting SQL and explicit omissions, not a conventional database-derived SQL export.
Measured local protocol-count reductions are not a claimed cloud-model speedup. Dependency-sensitive mapping remains serial; unknown model outcomes are never automatically repeated.
